I have mixed feelings about this salon because some services were excellent, while others were disappointing.

First, the pedicure was outstanding. The technician was very thorough, took great care of my skin and cuticles, and applied the gel polish beautifully. It has been almost two weeks since my pedicure and it still looks great.

The salon itself is beautiful, clean, and very professional. The hospitality is exceptional – guests are offered drinks and small snacks before and after the treatment. The overall atmosphere feels comparable to a high-quality European salon.

My husband also had a Thai massage and was very satisfied. According to him, it was above average compared to many other Thai massages he has experienced.

Unfortunately, my manicure was a major disappointment.

My cuticles were not properly treated, and the manicure already looked grown out on the same day because the product was applied too far from the cuticle area. The nail shapes and lengths were inconsistent, and even after I asked for corrections, the final result was still uneven.

The biggest issue was the nail preparation. I only had gel polish previously, but the technician treated my nails as if they had hard gel and over-filed them significantly. During the procedure I repeatedly indicated that it was painful, but the filing continued. My natural nails are now extremely thin, sensitive, and feel almost like paper. Even simple daily activities are uncomfortable.

The gel polish application itself was also below expectations. The product is uneven in several places, with visible bumps and thickness inconsistencies. Some edges were not properly finished, and the polish was applied untidily around the sides of the nails. Overall, the manicure does not look like a freshly completed professional service.

It is a shame because the salon, pedicure, hospitality, and massage were all excellent. However, due to the poor manicure quality and the damage caused to my natural nails, I cannot recommend the manicure service and would not choose it again.

I think I am a pretty reasonable person, but when I went for my nail appointment there was major construction happening right at the entrance. The whole time all I could hear was drilling and banging. Normally I would have left and gone elsewhere, but as a mum with limited time, I did not have that luxury.

When people go to a salon, they expect at least some kind of relaxing experience. I really think appointments should have been declined during that time or at the very least clients should have been informed beforehand so they could decide for themselves.

The nail technician seemed friendly at first and smiled when I arrived and left( infront of other staff members), but the way she handled me and spoke throughout the appointment was passive aggressive. She kept burning my nails and I was physically pulling my hand away and telling her, but there was no apology or kindness, just comments like “your nails are too weak” whilehuffing and puffing.

I have been going to salons for over 12 years, and while the occasional nail might feel a bit hot during a session (to be expected), I have never had every single nail burn so much like that before. My nails are very normal and I have never experienced this elsewhere.

I was also often left waiting while she chose which YouTube video to put on, with both AirPods in and the volume loud enough that I could hear her music too. So not only was there constant construction noise, but also her music playing at the same time.

Overall, the salon looks lovely, but the experience lacked kindness, professionalism and basic etiquette.

Review:
I came to Le Karn Spa for a hair spa, manicure, and facial treatment – and left feeling like a brand new (and much more glamorous) person. Everything was sensationally good.

Not only was every single step done with loving care, but also every single touch was pure professionalism. My hair finally behaves, my nails look like tiny works of art, and my face? Glowing like a full moon party (minus the hangover).

The place is super clean and beautifully decorated – you could literally eat off the floor… but please don’t, just enjoy the amazing treatments instead. 😄

And the owner? Super friendly, super funny – he had me laughing so hard I almost forgot I was being pampered. A great sense of humor is clearly part of their special spa menu.

If you're on Koh Samui and want to leave looking better and feeling happier, go to Le Karn Spa. Your hair, face, nails – and your laugh muscles – will thank you.
